# Intellumia

> Intellumia, the AI partner for owner-run businesses.

Intellumia shows owner-run businesses where AI makes them money, runs the parts that do with named professionals signing off, and takes no vendor fees.

Where can AI make you money? We find it in your numbers. Then we run it for you.

Sundeep Kumar, Founder & CEO.

## Most owner-run businesses have money hiding in plain sight.

These leaks are not new. Fixing them took hours of checking, chasing and counting that nobody had time for. AI now does that work every day, so the money stops slipping away.

- Costs up, prices stuck? Your costliest process, done a better way.
- Customers paying late? Every overdue invoice, followed up on time. Often first.
- Good people leaving? Routine work off your best people.
- Numbers always late? One page across your companies, every week.
- Too much made twice? Defects caught earlier.
- All on your desk? Decisions arrive with the facts ready.

AI does the work. Your people make the calls.

## How it works

A Map first. Then we run the parts that pay.

- Map (start here): We find where AI would make you the most money, across the whole business, in two to three weeks. Always paid, for a fee agreed up front.
- Run (if you choose): We run the moves you choose. AI does the routine work, a named professional checks it and signs off, and you see the result every week.
- Guide (alongside): Independent advice on AI, vendors and your board. We take no fees from vendors.

The Map, week by week:

- Start: summaries only.
- Week 1: interviews with you and your team.
- Week 2: each move valued and tested on your records.
- Week 3: the readout, to you alone.

About 20 to 40 hours of your staff's time, agreed before we start.

## One example, step by step

From an overdue invoice to money collected (illustrative, not a client):

1. AI reads the record. Invoice, payments and emails in one view. It spots that the customer asked for a delivery note.
2. AI prepares the next step. It finds the delivery note and drafts the follow-up.
3. Your people decide. Your finance team approves what goes to the customer. A named professional reviews the exceptions.
4. You see the result. Every week: days to collect, overdue balance and the time your team spent.

## Our rules

On your side of the table, in writing.

1. Valued first. Every move is valued in your numbers before you commit to any build.
2. No vendor fees. No referral fees and no resale margins, ever. Our advice is paid for by you alone.
3. Your data stays put. In your own environment, with models that neither keep nor train on it.
4. Yours to keep. What we build with you is yours, with the right to run it without us.

## Questions owners ask

Before you book.

- What does a Map cost? A fixed fee, agreed before we start and always paid. We share it on the first call, once we know the size of your business.
- Is our data safe? We start with summaries, never all your books on day one. Your data stays in your own environment, with models that neither keep nor train on it.
- Will this replace our people? It is not built to cut jobs. AI takes the routine work, and your people review and decide. The Map shows where time is freed; what you do with it is your call.
- Are we tied in after the Map? No. You keep everything the Map produces. Each move names at least one way to do it without us, and the fee never depends on what you choose next.
